# Vendored code

Nothing yet. This directory is the place for source that is copied into the
tree and compiled (an amalgamation, a single-file parser), as opposed to the
git submodules under `libs/firstparty/`.

The first-party framework libraries (`App_shell`, `Vk_Canvas_Lb_LAW`,
`archive_engine`) and the UI fonts are submodules; see `.gitmodules`.
